simulador.ayuda: Change a column and see how many of the model's decisions move and what that means in money. It is a simulation with the model's own probabilities, not a measured result: rows that do not exist have no real answer.
simulador.nota_entrenamiento: The rows that move are the training rows: the test was opened once in stage 8 and is not opened again. What you simulate here does not enter the notebook or change any stage.
simulador.sin_columnas: This model has no columns to change.

cambio.porcentaje: Raise or lower by a percentage
cambio.porcentaje_valor: Percentage (10 raises it by 10 %, -10 lowers it by 10 %)

alcance.valor_invalido: Write the value with a decimal point and no thousands separator (1500.5).

costos.ayuda: Without costs you only see how many decisions change. With them, the expected cost of each decision comes from the model's probabilities.
costos.ayuda_etapa1: These are the costs you wrote in stage 1.
costos.fp: Cost of acting when it was not needed (false positive)
costos.fn: Cost of not acting when it was needed (false negative)
costos.clase: Cost of being wrong when the real class is «{clase}»
costos.invalido: Write a number greater than zero.
costos.clases_faltan: Write the cost of every class to see the money.

simulador.ajustando: Refitting the winner with the training rows… The test is not opened.

rechazo.columna: That column is not one of the model's columns.
rechazo.cambio: That change does not work for that column.
rechazo.valor: Write a number within the limits.
rechazo.categoria: That category does not exist in the column: pick one that does.
rechazo.segmento: The segment is not written correctly.
rechazo.sin-filas: There are no rows to simulate.

simulador.ayuda_verificada: Every figure in this text comes from the simulation. It is a check of the text, not a guarantee that the model is right.
simulador.no_cuadro: The text did not match your numbers, so only the figures are shown.

resumen.binaria: Of {n} rows, the model recommends acting on {antes} and, with the change, on {despues}: {cambian} decisions change.
resumen.umbral: It acts from a probability of {umbral}, the one your costs give.
resumen.multiclase: Of {n} rows, {cambian} change option with the change.
resumen.numerica: Of {n} rows, the estimated value changes by {cambio} on average: the average goes from {antes} to {despues}.
resumen.agrupar: Of {n} rows, {cambian} change group with the change.
resumen.dinero: With your costs, the expected cost per 100 decisions goes from {costo_antes} to {costo_despues} ({delta}).

sin_dinero.sin-costos: Without your costs there is no figure in money: write them to see it.
sin_dinero.sin-probabilidades: This model decides without giving probabilities, so there is no expected cost to compute.

resumen.binaria_one: Of {n} rows, the model recommends acting on {antes} and, with the change, on {despues}: {cambian} decision changes.
resumen.multiclase_one: Of {n} rows, {cambian} changes option with the change.
resumen.agrupar_one: Of {n} rows, {cambian} changes group with the change.

simulador.muestra: {usadas} of {total} rows were simulated (a sample with a fixed seed).
simulador.toco: The change modified the value of {tocadas} rows.
simulador.no_toco: The change did not modify any row: check the column, the value or the segment.
simulador.fuera: Heads up: with the change, {despues} rows fall outside what the model saw in training (before: {antes}); there the estimate is an extrapolation.
simulador.toco_one: The change modified the value of {tocadas} row.
simulador.fuera_one: Heads up: with the change, {despues} row falls outside what the model saw in training (before: {antes}); there the estimate is an extrapolation.
